This page shows some formatting options available in pages content. You can take
a look at the `formatting.qmd` file to see which markdown syntax is used.

## Basic formatting

Text can be put in **bold**, _italic_ or `verbatim`.

It is possible to create lists:

- item 1
- item 2
- item 3

Which can be ordered:

1. item 1
2. item 2
3. item 3

URLs can be inserted as is:

<https://example.com>

Or [as a link](https://example.com).

You can also link to another site page like [publications](publications.qmd).

Footnotes are available too^[This is a very interesting footnote].

## Verbatim and source code

Text can be shown verbatim in a monospace font.

```
My name is Darouine
I like evolving
Everythin I'm doing
Is very interesting
```

For source code, syntax highlighting is available.

```python
def hello() -> None:
    print("Hello")
```

```r
hello <- function() { print("Hello") }
```

## Images and figures

It is possible to insert images:

![](assets/profile.jpg)

Images can be resized:

![](assets/profile.jpg){width=150}

![](assets/profile.jpg){width=30%}

If a caption is provided, the image becomes a figure:

![Charles Darouine self portrait](assets/profile.jpg)

By adding `lightbox: true` in the page preamble, each image and is shown at a
bigger size when clicked.

## Tables

Tables are possible, but not that easy to type.

| Default | Left | Right | Center |
| ------- | :--- | ----: | :----: |
| 12      | 12   |    12 |   12   |
| 123     | 123  |   123 |  123   |
| 1       | 1    |     1 |   1    |

: We can even add a table caption

## Complex layout

::: {.column-margin}

![Hello there](assets/profile.jpg)

:::

You can have complex layouts such as full page sections, content in the margins
like the above beautiful picture, etc.

## Equations

It is possible to format mathematics using the standard LaTeX syntax.

$$\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sqrt{x}$$

## Citations

If you provide a bibliography file you can easily insert citations like
[@darouine2026, p. 42]. A References section will be automatically added at the
end of the page.
